_readme: Generated-image index — check here before generating a new image and reuse what already exists. gen.py registers every successful generation automatically; run build_manifest.py to refresh after manual cleanup. transparent=true means a .cut.webp real-alpha cutout exists. assets.name: china-clay-title2
assets.prompt: A single handmade polymer clay 3D title sticker floating on a plain pure white background with a wide empty white margin all around. Chunky hand-rolled pastel clay capital letters, thick, rounded, soft bevelled edges, subtle fingerprint texture, glossy studio lighting. Exactly two lines of text, both lines centred on the same vertical axis and the SAME letter height, no other objects, no icons, no moon, no decorations: the first line reads MOON OF, the second line reads QIN. Letters alternate coral, mint green, butter yellow and lavender clay. Every letter fully visible and complete, generous spacing between letters, nothing touching the image edges.
assets.note: 中国大陆 2026 测试行程(封面/地形带补做,owner 08-15 反馈后)

assets.name: china-splash-hero
assets.prompt: A single large floating-island hero vignette centred on a plain pure white background with a wide white margin all around it, painted in Supercell Brawl Stars splash art style: hand-painted stylized 2.5D, soft airbrushed volume shading inside bold clean silhouettes, chunky exaggerated proportions, magenta and cyan rim light. A big floating rock chunk with a green ridge on top, along which a chunky crenellated ancient stone wall snakes up to a square watchtower at the summit; on a lower shelf of the same floating chunk stands a small tiered pagoda beside two chunky terracotta warrior statues; small floating rock bits and a few red paper lanterns drift below the island, with soft mist puffs and three tiny sparkles. No ground plane, no shadows on the white background, no text, no labels
assets.note: 中国大陆 2026(纽约出发,英文) 测试行程(Opus 测试员生成)

assets.name: china-splash-title
assets.prompt: A single hand-painted game title plate floating on a plain pure white background with a wide white margin all around it, painted in Supercell Brawl Stars splash art style: thick painterly capital letters with heavy dark outlines, glossy bevelled faces, magenta and cyan rim light and a soft golden glow behind them. The plate spells exactly two short lines of English text, centred: the first line reads MOON OF and the second, larger line reads QIN. A slim crescent moon sits at the upper right of the lettering and a thin gold banner ribbon curls under it. No other text, no letters other than the words MOON OF QIN, no watermark, no shadows on the white background
